digest.component_or_area: git-fetch test suite and stall detection
propositions: git-fetch dribble tests intermittently misclassify valid traffic as stalled under full-suite scheduler load due to shared 2-second timing window between stall and dribble controls
fixture sends rate//10 bytes per 0.1-second wake-up, and delayed scheduler wake-ups reduce actual throughput below promised rate, causing spurious low-speed aborts
cumulative catch-up pacing fixes repeated late wake-ups but cannot recover once libcurl aborts during an uninterrupted scheduling gap that exceeds the configured window
deterministic unit test of cumulative bytes-owed math must replace scheduler-dependent fixture timing trials
production 10-second low-speed window must remain unchanged; only zero-byte stall tests should use the fast 2-second window
